title: Explain a failed test
question: How do you explain a failed hidden test without revealing it?
observableCriteria: The public contract and the boundary category are described without claiming to know the private inputs
The candidate's own incorrect assumption is named, and a regression test is added
modelAnswer: I describe the public contract, the boundary category and my incorrect assumption. I do not claim knowledge of private inputs and I add my own regression case.
commonMistakes: Guessing at the hidden inputs instead of describing the boundary that was missed
variants: Changez une contrainte du scénario « Explain a failed test » et expliquez si la décision reste valide.
